Frequently asked questions

How many Data Engineer jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 68 open Data Engineer jobs in the United States as of November 25, 2026.

How much do Data Engineer jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $109,000–$158,600 a year, based on 14 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for Data Engineer jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include CrowdStrike (11 listings), Prime Therapeutics (8 listings), CYNET SYSTEMS (7 listings), SynergisticIT (6 listings), and Insight Global (4 listings).

Are there entry-level Data Engineer jobs in the United States?

6 listings mention entry-level, new-grad, junior or graduate roles in the title or description. Review the original posting for its experience requirements.

Is every listing fully remote from any state?
